title: Cooperation with National Labor Relations Board.
bodyText: The conciliator and the board shall cooperate with the National Labor Relations Board and its agents and representatives.
bodyHtml: §377-18  Cooperation with National Labor Relations Board.  The conciliator and the board shall cooperate with the National Labor Relations Board and its agents and representatives. [L 1945, c 250, §20; RL 1955, §90-19; HRS §377-18; am L 1985, c 251, §25]
